decision: Keep current default transport. Packing cuts requests but average desktop readiness is slightly slower across three samples. Worker/mobile samples are promising but insufficient to justify changing defaults. Experimental worker and generated pack paths are opt-in; no alternate meshes, quantization or hidden interiors. Heap readings are approximate Chromium measurements and omit GPU and worker heaps.
